messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: rstan expose_stan_functions not exposing stan functions
parts:
On Wednesday, March 22, 2017 at 8:51:51 PM UTC-4, Justin Silverman wrote:
 I am having a bit of an issue trying to expose the two functions in the attached stan function. 

I get the following error and the functions are not exposed:

I fixed it. You can do

source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stan-dev/rstan/develop/rstan/rstan/R/expose_stan_functions.R")

and it will work without having to install all of rstan from GitHub.

Ben
